name: Chloro - Houseplant Care Tool
summary:
**Chloro is currently in closed beta. More plants, features, and polish are on the way. Join the Discord to share feedback, report bugs, and help shape future updates.**


# Plan Your Indoor Jungle
Choose from 27 houseplants, with more coming soon, and place them anywhere in your room using hand tracking or controllers.
